lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Type the email address for your back-office account. [[slnc 800]] Then click Send Code.

lines.label: enter-the-code
lines.said: A four-digit code is sent to that address. [[slnc 500]] Type it in — the screen moves on by itself.

lines.label: dashboard
lines.said: This is your dashboard. [[slnc 800]] Questions are shared by every store. Click Questions.

lines.label: question-list
lines.said: This lists every question you have. [[slnc 500]] Click the plus button to add a new one.

lines.label: new-question
lines.said: Give the question a name. [[slnc 800]] Then choose its type. Select One gives the renter a short list to pick from. [[slnc 800]] Now create it.

lines.label: question-details
lines.said: Now the details. [[slnc 800]] The inquiry is what the renter reads. [[slnc 800]] The label is the short name on their form. [[slnc 800]] Add the options they can choose between, [[slnc 500]] set the status to Active, [[slnc 500]] and update.

lines.label: back-to-questions
lines.said: A new question starts as a draft, [[slnc 500]] and a draft cannot be attached to anything. [[slnc 800]] So we go back to Questions to switch it on.

lines.label: find-the-question
lines.said: Type part of the name, [[slnc 500]] then pick your question from the list.

lines.label: the-question
lines.said: This is the question you just made. [[slnc 500]] Everything you typed is still here.

lines.label: activate
lines.said: Change the status to Active, [[slnc 800]] then update. [[slnc 800]] A requirement can use it now.

lines.label: back-to-dashboard
lines.said: Head back to the dashboard. [[slnc 500]] You can get here anytime with the command + K short keys.

lines.label: sign-out
lines.said: Click Logout to finish. [[slnc 500]] You are signed out.
